statement: The site's media bucket on R2 has no backup or second copy: a deletion, a provider failure or a compromised write key loses the course media.

treatment.plan: Cut made on 2026-11-18 (D-323 step 2): the media primary is the versioned S3 bucket of the media stack (noncurrent versions 90 days) and R2 is a second byte-identical copy for 30 days. A deletion or a provider failure no longer loses the media. The live R2 write key can only touch the second copy; its revocation is a credential step of D-323 step 4, left to the owner (the Torre's connector cannot revoke Cloudflare API tokens).
